Graduate Data Engineer — Northwind Analytics (Kuala Lumpur, hybrid)

Northwind Analytics helps mid-sized retailers understand their inventory. Our data team is four people, so whoever joins will own a pipeline within their first month rather than watching someone else run it.

What you will do:
- Build and maintain batch pipelines that land retail transaction data into our warehouse
- Model that data into tables analysts can query without asking us questions
- Write the documentation and the weekly update that goes to non-technical stakeholders
- Investigate data quality issues and fix them at the source

What we are looking for:
- Solid Python and SQL fundamentals (we care more about depth than breadth)
- Some experience building an ETL or data pipeline, even a personal project
- Nice to have: exposure to AWS or GCP, dbt, or an orchestrator like Airflow
- Nice to have: comfort explaining technical work to people who are not engineers

Fresh graduates are welcome. We do not require prior full-time experience.
cv:
A. Graduate — BSc Computer Science, Universiti Malaya (2025), CGPA 3.6

Final Year Project — Retail Demand Dashboard
Built a Python data pipeline that ingested a 2 million row public retail dataset into PostgreSQL, cleaned inconsistent product codes, and modelled the result into fact and dimension tables. Wrote SQL views the dashboard queried directly. Presented the project to a panel that included two non-technical assessors.

Coursework — Web Scraper
Wrote a Python scraper that collected daily price data from three e-commerce sites, deduplicated results, and stored them in SQLite. Added retry logic after the job kept failing overnight.

Internship — IT Support Intern, 3 months
Handled internal tickets and wrote a small Python script that automated a weekly Excel report the team had been building by hand.

Skills: Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, pandas, Git, basic Linux
Activities: Treasurer, Computer Science Society — managed a RM12,000 budget and reported it to the committee each month.
